install_output_empty: Tewali bifulumizibwa n'okutuusa kati. Layini za terminal okuva mu kikozesebwa mu kussaako zijja kulabika wano.
linux_setup_title: Linux Flashing & SP Flash Ebikozesebwa Okuteekawo
linux_setup_welcome: Okuteekawo Ekintu kya SP Flash Tool ku Linux
linux_setup_welcome_desc: Okuwanula n’okusengeka yingini eyaka ku sipiidi ey’amaanyi osobole okuzzaawo n’okulongoosa omuzannyi wo awatali kufuba kwonna.
linux_card_engine_title: Yingini Eyaka (Ekikozesebwa mu Kumasamasa ekya SP) .
linux_card_engine_desc: MediaTek native flashing tool n'okukwatagana kw'etterekero ly'ebitabo ery'ensi yonna ku siteegi.
linux_card_usb_desc: Ewa olukusa lwa desktop okuwuliziganya n'omuzannyi mu mbeera ya Bootloader.
system_checker_title: SP Flash Tool System Checker & Okuzuula obulwadde
system_checker_desc: Okukakasa okujjuvu kwa ddereeva, modulo za kernel, olukusa, n'amaterekero g'ebiseera by'okudduka okukakasa okumasamasa okwesigika.
settings_checker_desc_installer: Eteekateeka kompyuta yo okuyungibwa ku muzannyi wo okusobola okulongoosa pulogulaamu za kompyuta.
settings_checker_desc_advanced: Ekebera ensengeka ya Linux ey'omulembe ku SP Flash Tool, okuyingira kwa USB, olukusa lwa serial, n'ebitundu by'enkola.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: Efuna kompyuta yo nga yeetegese okuyungibwa ku muzannyi wo n’okussaamu ebipya bya pulogulaamu mu ngeri eyesigika.
settings_checker_desc: Efuna kompyuta yo nga yeetegese okuyungibwa ku muzannyi wo n’okussaamu ebipya bya pulogulaamu mu ngeri eyesigika.
linux_prep_ready_friendly: Kompyuta yo yeetegefu okuyungibwa ku muzannyi wo.
linux_prep_connected_friendly: Omuzannyi azuuliddwa, azza obuggya okuyingira kw'omukutu...
linux_prep_blocked: Kompyuta eno tesobola kukola SP Flash Tool.
linux_prep_fix_body: Password yo yeetaagibwa omulundi gumu okuteekawo kompyuta eno okumasamasa: amateeka ga USB ku byuma bya MediaTek n’okuyingira ku serial port.
linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Okuteekawo kompyuta eno ku SP Flash Tool, password yo ejja kwetaagisa mu mutendera oguddako okutegeka amateeka ga USB n’okwongera akawunti yo mu bibinja by’abakozesa eby’omuddiring’anwa ebyetaagisa. Bw’ogaana, okusaba kujja kuggalawo.
linux_prep_fixed: Okuyingira kukkirizibwa, SP Flash Tool yeetegese.
linux_prep_reboot_body: Okuteekawo kuwedde era akawunti yo eyongezeddwa ku bibinja by'abakozesa ebyetaagisa ku SP Flash Tool. Nkusaba oddemu okutandika kompyuta yo olukusa olupya lutandike okukola, olwo oddemu oggule app. Nywa ku kabonero akalaga nti oggalawo app kati.
linux_prep_reboot_done_btn: Kiwedde, Ggala App okuddamu Okutandika Kompyuta
settings_driver_desc: Nga tonnaba kukozesa app eno omulundi ogusooka, olina okussaamu MediaTek USB driver, olwo n’oddamu okutandika kompyuta yo.
home_desc: Funa firmware ku yintaneeti oba londa package y’omu kitundu, olwo ogifuule flash ku kyuma kyo.
sel_source_desc: Wano wefunire firmware ku yintaneeti, oba yingizaamu package ya wano.
settings_advanced_desc: Eraga enkola y'okussaako, engeri y'okussaako n'ebisengejja okufulumya.
settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_guided_install: Nlungamya okuyita mu install mu app
settings_guided_install_desc: App esigala naawe okuyita mu kuggyako amasannyalaze, okuyunga, n’okugiteeka.
settings_terminal_install: Teeka okuva ku ddirisa lya terminal
settings_sp_gui_install: Teeka mu SP Flash Tool GUI
settings_sp_gui_desc: Eggalawo Updater n'eggulawo SP Flash Tool GUI nga fayiro ya firmware scatter n'ebifaananyi by'okugabanya ebirondeddwa bitikkiddwa.
settings_terminal_desc: Eddukanya software installation yo mu Terminal osobole okulaba technical info ku progress.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Eddukanya software installation yo mu Command Prompt osobole okulaba technical info ku progress.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Kya kusalawo. Ebimu ku bigendererwa bya MediaTek bigaana okumasamasa okutuusa nga SP Flash Tool eweereddwa fayiro y'okukakasa (.auth); yongera wano ebibyo singa ekyuma kyetaaga ekimu.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Tewali fayiro ya kusaasaanya yasangibwa mu package eno, kale tewali kiragiro kya console kyali kisobola kuzimbibwa.
terminal_install_no_tool: Tewali SP Flash Tool build oba MTKClient entry point eriwo ku nkola eno.
terminal_install_failed: Teyasobodde kuggulawo ddirisa lya terminal. Ekiragiro install kyawandiikibwa ku {path}.
status_terminal_install: Teeka ekiragiro ekigguddwawo mu ddirisa lyo erya terminal ({path}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} kati ejja kuggulawo ng’edduka {method}.

• Bwe kiba nga tekinnaggwaako, ssaako amasannyalaze {device} yo.
• Bw’eba eyungiddwa ku USB, sooka ogiggyeko.
{hint} .
• Yunga ekyuma kyo ku kompyuta yo ng’eddirisa lya {terminal_name} ligguddewo.

Nywa ku OK okutongoza n'okufuluma Updater.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Amagezi: Singa ekyuma tekiyungibwa mu ngeri ya otomatiki, nyweza mpola bbaatuuni ya reset mu kinnya kya ppini ng’okozesa ekikwaso ky’empapula ng’oyunga waya ya USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Amagezi: Teeka ekyuma kyo mu mbeera y’okuwanula firmware (kyawukana okusinziira ku mulembe: e.g. ggyawo bbaatule era ogikuume nga ebweru nga waya ya USB eyungiddwa, oba okuggyako amasannyalaze nga bbaatule eyingidde, oba kwata Volume Down/Up ng’oyungako USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Teeka ng’oyita mu SP Flash Tool GUI
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI kati ejja kugguka nga firmware yo etekeddwa.

• Mu SP Flash Tool, londa "Download" okuva mu kasanduuko akakka wansi.
• Nywa ku bbaatuuni ya "Download".
• Kakasa nti {device} yo evuddeko amasannyalaze era ng’ekutuddwako.
{hint} .
• Yunga waya ya USB ku kompyuta yo oluvannyuma lw’okunyiga ku Download.

Nywa ku OK okutongoza SP Flash Tool n'ofuluma mu Updater.
settings_install_themes_desc: Bwe kikozesebwa, emiramwa gya Rockbox gikyusibwa butereevu mu Y1 ne Y2 oluvannyuma lw’okussaako Rockbox obulungi.
themes_placement_failed_note: Tetwasobodde kuteeka themes pack ku muzannyi wo. Osobola okuddamu okugezaako okuva ku Settings.
settings_rockbox_desc: Ekozesebwa nga olambula ebifulumizibwa mu pulogulaamu.
settings_filter_original_pre307: Laga ebifulumizibwa bya Original Software ebikadde okusinga 3.0.7
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Original Software releases ezisukka 3.0.7 tezikwatagana na Y1 units ezitundibwa ne Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Flashing an older build ku units zino kijja kuziremesa okutandika okutuusa nga version empya ezzeemu okuteekebwa.

Okakasa nti oyagala kulaga Original Software releases ezikadde okusinga 3.0.7?
settings_240p_tip: Alaga ebizimbe nga zip ya ROM yaayo ya 240p variant (rom..._240p.zip). 240p builds tezikwatagana na Y1 units ku Innioasis OS wansi wa 3.0.7, kale Show Old Rockbox Builds ekozesebwa nayo.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Rockbox-Y1 ezifulumiziddwa nga 0.5 tezinnabaawo tezikwatagana na yuniti za Y1 ezatundibwa oluvannyuma lwa March 2026 nga Innioasis OS 3.0.7 etekeddwako.

Flashing an older build ku byuma bino kijja kulemesa okutandika.

Okakasa nti oyagala kulaga Rockbox builds enkadde?
sel_back_to_online: ← Okudda ku Sofutiweya y’enkola ku mutimbagano
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Nkusaba olonde .zip, .rar archive, oba fayiro y'okusaasaanya (*scatter*.txt) munda mu folda ya firmware okuteeka firmware gy'olonze ku {target} yo.
sel_offline: Ebiwandiiko ebiri ku yintaneeti tebiriiwo mu kiseera kino. Kozesa fayiro y'omu kitundu, oba kebera omukago gwo.
rockbox_themes_notice_body: Rockbox on Y1 no longer supports iPod classic (240p) themes from Rockbox.org. You'll have to use 360p Rockbox themes made for Y1. Click next to continue.
sel_multiple_scatters_error: Firmware packages eziwera oba scatter files zasangibwa mu folda/archive eno. Nkusaba olonde folda oba archive erimu firmware package emu yokka omulundi gumu.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Ekiwandiiko kino kirimu fayiro ezisukka mu emu ez'okusaasaanya, kale Updater tesobola kumanya layout ki omuzannyi wo gy'ayagala. Omukozi wa {software} yandibadde yeetaaga okulongoosa ebifulumizibwa byabwe ebya firmware okussaamu fayiro emu yokka eya scatter.
sp_search_restart: Tewali kyuma n'okutuusa kati, okuddamu okunoonya (okugezaako {count}). Kuuma omuzannyi ng’azikidde era ogiyunge nga osabiddwa.
sp_auth_missing_file: Fayiro y'okukakasa tezuuliddwa ({path}); okumasamasa nga tewali.
sp_config_missing_platform: Fayiro y'okusaasaanya telangirira pulatifomu yaayo, kale ensengeka ya console ya fayiro y'okukakasa teyasobodde kuzimbibwa; okumasamasa nga tewali.
sp_config_missing_storage: Fayiro y'okusaasaanya telangirira kika kya kutereka (EMMC/NAND/UFS), kale ensengeka ya console ya fayiro y'okukakasa teyasobodde kuzimbibwa; okumasamasa nga tewali.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Tewali fayiro ya kukakasa yaweebwa; okumasamasa nga tewali n’omu.
sp_config_write_failed: Teyasobodde kuwandiika fayiro y'okusengeka console; okumyansa nga tewali fayiro y'okukakasa.
settings_notifications_desc: Laga okumanyisibwa kw'enkola ku kiwandiiko n'ebika by'okulongoosa wansi. Off ekuuma buli kimu munda mu app.
settings_notifications_general: Ebirango ebikwata ku mawulire aga bulijjo
settings_add_device_type_hint: Ekika kye kifaananyi ky’omuzannyi eky’okuddamu okutunula mu byuma (hardware revision). Abazannyi ab’omulembe gwe gumu basobola okuzimbibwa mu kuddamu okusukka mu kumu — okugeza Ekika A ne Ekika B — era pulogulaamu ekolebwa ku emu ku zo. Kebera sitiika eri emabega w’omuzannyi; bwe kiba tekituuma linnya lya kika, lekawo okulonda okusooka.
settings_add_device_no_versions: Tewali nkyusa ziriwo ku pulogulaamu eno mu kiseera kino.
settings_notifications_unavailable: Okumanyisibwa kw’enkola tekuliiwo ku kompyuta eno.
settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Kuuma app mu menu bar oluvannyuma lw’eddirisa okuggalwa, kale okyafuna app ne player firmware update notifications. Off: okuggalawo eddirisa kiva mu app.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Kuuma app mu system tray oluvannyuma lw’eddirisa okuggalwa, kale okyafuna app ne player firmware update notifications. Off: okuggalawo eddirisa kiva mu app.
settings_offline_mode_desc: Kweka katalogu y’ekitundu ku yintaneeti era oteekemu pulogulaamu okuva mu fayiro z’omu kitundu zokka.
sel_themepack_prompt_body: Ofunye flash ya 360p Rockbox build. Wandyagadde okuteeka 360p Theme Pack ku kyuma kino kati?
sel_themepack_guidance_title: Yunga Player mu USB Storage Mode
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Nsaba oggyeko USB, okole amaanyi era oteeke mu Rockbox omulundi gumu (bwe kityo n’etandika ekitabo kyayo eky’enkola ya .rockbox ey’omunda), olwo oddemu okuyunga USB n’olonda ‘USB Storage Mode’.

Bw’oba ​​oyungiddwa, nyweza Continue okulonda folda yonna ku muzannyi wo.
sel_themepack_select_folder: Londa folda yonna ku storage y'omuzannyi wo ayungiddwa
sel_themepack_success: Rockbox Theme Pack essiddwa bulungi ku kyuma kyo!
sel_dialog_filter: Fayiro za Firmware (*.zip *.rar * okusaasaana *.txt *.txt);;Etterekero (*.zip *.rar);;Fayiro ezisaasaanya (* okusaasaanya*.txt *.txt);;Fayiro zonna (*.*)
sel_only_local: Londa .zip oba .rar firmware package ya wano, oba fayiro ya folda / scatter .txt, okugiteeka nga tolina mukutu, tekyetaagisa yintaneeti. Ekola ne buli Innioasis ne Timmkoo audio player.
sel_only_local_generic: Londa firmware package ya wano (.zip, .rar) oba folda erimu fayiro y'okusaasaanya okuteekebwa ku mutimbagano, ekola n'ebyuma bya MediaTek ebya bulijjo.
sel_offline_install: Teeka firmware okuva mu fayiro .zip oba .rar ku Innioasis oba Timmkoo audio player yonna.
sel_offline_install_generic: Teeka firmware okuva mu .zip/.rar archive oba firmware folder ku byuma bya MediaTek ebya bulijjo.
sel_update_available: Waliwo update ku {software} eriwo ku {model} yo.
conn_offline: Oli offline. Ebiteekeddwa okuva mu Community Firmware Archive tebiriiwo.
conn_action_online: Funa pulogulaamu za kompyuta ku yintaneeti
conn_archive_unavailable: Katalogu ya firmware tesobola kutuukirirwa okumala akaseera. Okyayinza okuteeka okuva mu archive oba fayiro z'omu kitundu.
single_instance_body: Kopi endala eggule, oba ekyadduka mu mugongo. Kopi bbiri zandivuganyizza ku USB connection y’omuzannyi, kale eno tegenda kutandika.
single_instance_focus_failed: Kopi edduka teyaddamu kusaba kulaga ddirisa lyayo. Kiyinza okuba nga kirimu emirimu mingi oba nga kiwaniriddwa. Force okugivaako kijja kusalako ekintu kyonna ky’eba eteeka.
single_instance_force_failed: Kopi edduka teyasobodde kumalibwawo. Giveeko ggwe kennyini, olwo oddemu otandike updater.
single_instance_busy_body: Kopi edduka kwe kuteeka pulogulaamu oba okwogera n’omuzannyi, kale okugimaliriza kati kyanditaataaganyizza ekyo. Okutongoza kuno kugenda kuggalawo; kozesa eddirisa eririwo oba akabonero kaayo aka menu bar nga okuteeka kuwedde.
toast_battery_charged: Kino nga tonnaba kukikozesa ku muzannyi wo, bbaatule ssaako waakiri essaawa emu
toast_battery_charged_device: Kino nga tonnakikozesa ku kyuma kyo, bbaatule ssaako waakiri essaawa emu
toast_background_notifications_menu_bar: Ssobozesa okumanyisibwa okw'emabega okufuna okulongoosa n'okufulumya okulabula ne bwe kiba nti Updater eggaddwa ku bbaala ya menu.
toast_background_notifications_system_tr: Ssobozesa okumanyisibwa okw'emabega okufuna okulongoosa n'okufulumya okulabula ne bwe kiba nti Updater eggaddwa ku system tray.
toast_release_notes_unavailable: Ebiwandiiko ebifulumizibwa tebiriiwo mu kiseera kino.
translate_unavailable_notice_body: Empeereza y’okuvvuunula ku yintaneeti mu kiseera kino tesobola kutuukirirwa oba eri ku cooldown. Ebiwandiiko ebifulumizibwa eby’olubereberye bijja kulagibwa mu kifo ky’ekyo.
translate_unavailable_hint: Okuvvuunula tekuliiwo okumala akaseera. Kebera ku yintaneeti yo oba ddamu ogezeeko oluvannyuma.
sel_notes_hint: Londa ekifulumizibwa okulaba ekiwandiiko kyakyo eky'enkyukakyuka
flash_wait_desc: Sooka okuggyako ekyuma kino. Bw’eba eyungiddwa naye nga tezuuliddwa, gezaako cable oba port ya USB ey’enjawulo.
dialog_pre_install_header: Nsaba okakasizza nti {model} yo evuddeko era nga teyungiddwa ku USB
dialog_pre_install_innioasis_tip:
• Ggyako ddala amasannyalaze ku kyuma kyo nga tonnatandika.
• Singa ekyuma kiba kifuuse bbugumu oba nga tekiddamu, kozesa ppini oba ekikwaso ky’empapula mu kinnya kya reset okukaka amasannyalaze okuggyako mu mbeera y’okuwanula.
• Kuuma waya ya USB ng’ekutuddwako mu kiseera kino.
• Nywa ku Continue, olwo oyunge ekyuma kyo ng’oyita mu USB ng’obuuziddwa.
dialog_pre_install_generic_tip:
• Ggyako ddala amasannyalaze ku kyuma kyo ekya MediaTek.
• Kuuma waya ya USB ng’ekutuddwako mu kiseera kino.
• Okusinziira ku mulembe, gezaako okuyunga nga bbaatule eyingiziddwa oba nga tolina (oba kwata Volume Down / Up ng’oyunga).
• Nywa ku Continue, olwo oyunge waya ya USB nga osabiddwa.
sel_keep_data_incompatible: Tetusobola kukuuma data yo ku install eno kubanga firmware yo eriwo kati tekwatagana na Keep Data.
flash_paperclip_explanation: Ggyako waya ya USB okozese ekikwaso ky’empapula oba ppini okunyiga bbaatuuni ya reset, olwo ogezeeko okuddamu okuyunga.
flash_hint_wall_charger: • Kirungi okuyunga omuzannyi ku chajingi ya bbugwe okumala eddakiika 30 okutuuka ku ssaawa nga tonnagezaako kugiyunga.
flash_hint_install_drivers: • Bw’oba ​​oli ku Windows, kakasa nti olina Okuteeka Ddereeva.
flash_hint_windows_reboot_driver: • Windows PCs zirina okuddamu okutandika oluvannyuma lw’okussaamu ddereeva nga tonnasooka kuzikozesa.
flash_keep_settings_option: Kuuma settings zange ne media zange
install_first_which_firmware: Sofutiweya ki ekola ku {model} yo mu kiseera kino?
install_first_which_firmware_hint: Bw’oba ​​tokakasa, londa ‘Other’ oba software gy’olowooza nti eyingiziddwa.
install_first_prerequisite_hint: Okugenda mu maaso n'okussaako kuno, nsaba okakasizza oba {model} yo yakola dda pulogulaamu ya base eyeetaagisa ({software}).
keep_data_only_compatible_hint: Tusobola okukuuma ensengeka zo n’emikutu gyo nga omuzannyi amaze okukola pulogulaamu eno oba enkyusa ekwatagana.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_y1: Tusobola okukuuma ensengeka zo ng’omuzannyi yakola dda pulogulaamu eno oba enkyusa ekwatagana.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_other: Tusobola okukuuma ensengeka zo n’emikutu gyo nga omuzannyi amaze okukola pulogulaamu eno oba enkyusa ekwatagana.
settings_allow_keep_data_any: Kiriza Keep Settings ne Media ku firmware yonna install
settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: Buuka ekibuuzo ky'okukwatagana. Kino kikozese ng’okakasa nti omuzannyi ajja kusigala ng’akola n’ensengeka zaayo eziriwo kati n’emikutu gy’amawulire.
err_keep_data_failed: Teyasobodde kukuuma nteekateeka zo n'emikutu gyo: ekitabo kya firmware tekiwandiikibwa. Tewali kintu kyonna kyateekebwawo.
flash_keep_data_tooltip: Akuuma ensengeka zo n’emikutu gyo ku muzannyi. Sofutiweya ezisigadde ziteekebwa nga bulijjo.
flash_keep_data_warning: Bw’ogenda mu maaso nga tolina kino, ensengeka zo n’emikutu gyo bijja kuddamu okuteekebwa ku tterekero ly’omuzannyi ery’omunda.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox_y1: Bw’ogenda mu maaso nga tolina kino, emiramwa gyo egya Rockbox, efonti n’ensengeka bijja kuggyibwawo. Omuziki gwo n’emikutu emirala bijja kusigala ku muzannyi.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox: Bw’ogenda mu maaso nga tolina kino, emiramwa gyo egya Rockbox, efonti n’ensengeka bijja kuggyibwawo, era n’okutereka okw’omunda kw’omuzannyi kujja kuddamu okuteekebwawo.
flash_keep_data_warning_y1: Bw’ogenda mu maaso nga tolina kino, ensengeka zo zijja kuddamu okuteekebwawo. Omuziki gwo n’emikutu emirala bijja kusigala ku muzannyi.
format_all_data_warning_y1: Firmware eno erina okuddamu okukola format y'okutereka okw'omunda kw'omuzannyi. Ensengeka eziterekeddwa zijja kusazibwamu; omuziki gwo n’emikutu emirala bijja kusigala mu kifo.
format_all_data_warning_other: Firmware eno erina okuddamu okukola format y'okutereka okw'omunda kw'omuzannyi. Ensengeka eziterekeddwa n'emikutu egiterekeddwa ku tterekero ezimbiddwamu bijja kusazibwamu. Media ku microSD yo esigala mu kifo.
format_all_confirm_question: Ddamu okusengeka okutereka okw'omunda ku {model} yo?
format_all_confirm_body: Okuteeka {software}, twetaaga okukola format y'okutereka kwo okw'omunda okwa {model}. {data_effect} .
format_all_recovery: Ggyako USB, olwo oteekemu ekikwaso ky’empapula oba ppini mu kinnya kya ppini eky’okuzzaawo ku {model} yo. Nywa ku Next okuddamu okugezaako mu Format All + Download mode.
err_pmt_format_required_desc: SP Flash Tool yategeeza nti emmeeza y’okugabanya omuzannyi yakyuka (8502). Firmware eno erina okuteekebwa mu mbeera ya Format All + Download, eddaamu okusengeka okutereka okw’omunda.
install_first_hint: Nga tonnaba kuteekawo {target} omulundi ogusooka, {model} yo yeetaaga okuba ng’ekola {software} — oba {target} yennyini, singa eba yateekebwa dda era ng’ekola.
install_first_power_on_fmt: Nsaba oggyeko USB, ssaako {model} yo era onyige Next.
install_first_power_on_hint: Leka omuzannyi atandike omulundi gumu ku base firmware, olwo ogiggyeko amaanyi okusobola okugiteeka okuddako.
install_first_need_body: {target} ekola bulungi nga otandise ne {software} ku ​​{model} yo. Tujja kusooka kuteeka {software}, olwo tugende mu maaso ne {target} mu ngeri ey'otoma.
install_first_when_body: {target} terina kuteekebwa butereevu ku {running}. Ku {model} yo omuzannyi tajja kutandika bulungi oluvannyuma. Okusooka okuteeka {software} lye kkubo eritali lya bulabe, ate {target} olwo n'egoberera mu ngeri ey'otoma.
install_first_when_body_unnamed: {target} terina kuteekebwa butereevu ku software edda ku {model} yo: omuzannyi tajja kutandika bulungi oluvannyuma. Okusooka okuteeka {software} lye kkubo eritali lya bulabe, ate {target} olwo n'egoberera mu ngeri ey'otoma.
install_first_recommend_body: {model} yo eddukira {running}. Okuteeka {target} ku yo kiyinza okukuuma akabonero ka {running} ak'okutandika n'obubonero bw'ekyuma obw'enjawulo. Okusooka okuteeka {software} lye kkubo erisinga obuyonjo: {target} olwo ne ligoberera otomatiki. Yee asooka kuteeka {software}; Tewali installs {target} kati nga zirina settings empya ne media.
install_first_starting: Okuteeka firmware eya base eyeetaagisa {software} nga {target} tennabaawo.

support_story_1_headline: Abakola ebintu bwe bagenda mu maaso, abantu b’omukitundu beeyongera amaanyi.
support_story_1_lead: Okukuuma ekyuma kyo okuva ku mitego gya Hardware egisirise n’okuddamu okuddamu okumenyese.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis bulijjo efulumya firmwares empya eri abazannyi nga Y1 (nga etunuulidde okuddamu okukola ku bboodi ezikwese nga 6.0, 7.0, ne 8.0) ezimenya ebyuma ebikadde mu kasirise. Ekisinga obubi, omukutu gwabwe guwa zero okulabula ne zero access ku firmwares ezikola emabegako okudda engulu okuva mu mbeera ya bbulooka. Updater ne pulojekiti ya Community Firmware basitula ebitundu: tutereka buli legacy stock ROM, otomatiki okukakasa hardware yo okuddamu, era tukuuma omuzannyi wo nga akola bulungi.
support_story_1_item_1: Okununula Abazannyi Abamenyese: Okukebera obukuumi kukakasa nti ebipya ebipya tebikola bbulooka ku byuma ebikadde.
support_story_1_item_2: Archived Stock ROMs: Okukunganya okujjuvu okwa firmwares z'ekkolero ezasooka Innioasis esaziddwamu.
support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Ebikozesebwa ebijjuvu ebimasamasa ku macOS, Linux, ne Windows byonna.
support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Okuzuula board mu ngeri ey’otoma kale bulijjo ofuna package entuufu.
support_story_2_headline: Tewali Google Drives ezimenyese. Tewali kuteebereza-kukola. Firmware ekola yokka.
support_story_2_lead: Ebikozesebwa mu kitundu eby’amangu, ebikakasibwa by’osobola okwesigamako mu butuufu.
support_story_2_body: Okulondoola pulogulaamu entongole eya Innioasis kitera okutegeeza okunoonya emikutu gy’empuliziganya okuzuula enkolagana za Google Drive eziggwaako, okugabana ebire bya Baidu ebifu, ne fayiro za zip ez’ekyama nga tezirina bikozesebwa bitangalijja. Twazimba omukutu ogwesigika, ogwetongodde ogw’okuwanula nga gulina obulungi bwa SHA-256 obukakasibwa, okumanyisibwa okulongoosa, n’okussaako okulungamizibwa mu mitendera. Okuwaayo kwo kukuuma butereevu ebiwanulwa n’okukyaza ebisobozesa kino essaawa 24 buli lunaku, ennaku 365 omwaka.
support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Okuwanula amangu, obutereevu nga tewali kkomo ku kuwanula oba enkolagana enfu.
support_story_2_item_2: Update Notifications: Funa okutegeezebwa mu kaseera ebipya eby'omukitundu ebifulumiziddwa oba okutereeza we bigwa.
support_story_2_item_3: Guided Step-by-Step Installs: Ebiragiro ebirabika obulungi bikutambuza mu buli bbaatuuni gy’onyiga.
support_story_2_item_4: Ekibiina eky’ennimi Ennyingi: Mu bujjuvu mu kitundu mu Lungereza, Oluchina, Olugirimaani, Olusipeyini, Olufaransa & Olujapani.
support_story_3_headline: Okusumulula obusobozi obujjuvu obw'omuzannyi wo eya Innioasis.
support_story_3_lead: Okuleeta Rockbox, enkola z’emirimu ezitazitowa ku mutindo, n’eddembe lya audiophile.
support_story_3_body: Sofutiweya w’ekkolero lya sitokisi ekunya kungulu kwokka ku ekyo Hardware yo eya Y1 oba Y2 ky’esobola okukola. Ekitundu kyaffe kyaleeta Rockbox, enkola z’emirimu eza custom ezitazitowa, okuzannya codec za audiophile, n’emiramwa egy’enjawulo mu bulamu. Tugula enkyukakyuka za hardware ezirabika okuva mu nsawo okugezesa, okuddamu okukola yinginiya, n’okukakasa buli lwe tussaako. Okuwagira Updater kiwa ssente butereevu ku yuniti zino ez’okugezesa era kwanguyiza enkulaakulana ya firmware eya custom.
support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Okuzannya audiophile n’emiramwa egy’enjawulo egyateekebwa mu sikonda ntono.
support_story_3_item_2: Community Firmware: Okulongoosa bbaatule, UI ennyonjo, n'obuyambi bwa codec y'amaloboozi ey'omulembe.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Tugezesa ku byuma ebirabika ddala nga tetunnafulumya kuzimba kwonna.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% ya bwereere, software esooka ku by’ekyama nga tewali birango oba okulondoola.
support_story_4_lead: Okukuuma firmware ezikozesebwa abantu b’omukitundu nga zikuuma ebyuma byo nga tebiri mu bifo ebisuulibwamu kasasiro.
support_story_4_body: Kkampuni ya Hardware bw’egenda ku gadget yaabwe eddako, models enkadde zisuulibwa. Innioasis tewa buyambi bwa Linux, tewali nkyukakyuka za bwerufu, era tewali ngeri nnyangu ya kuddamu kukola nga okuteeka kulemererwa. Updater eriwo kubanga abakozesa abajjumbidde tebalina kusuula muziki mulungi ddala. Ebitundu 100% ku nsimbi z’abantu b’omukitundu zigenda butereevu mu kukuuma ekintu kino nga kiggule eri buli muntu.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Okuzzaawo okukakasibwa kukulukuta ne bwe kiba nti ebyuma bigaana okutandika.
support_story_4_item_2: Linux First-Class Support: Ewagirwa mu bujjuvu MediaTek eyaka ku Linux distros.
support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Ebiwandiiko ebifulumizibwa mu bujjuvu osobole okumanya bulungi ebikyuka.

retry_guidance_intro: USB connection ku player yo ekomye okuddamu. Omuzannyi wo yeetaaga okuddamu okuteekebwa mu ngalo nga tannagezaako kuddamu kukola.
retry_guidance_step_1: 1. Ggyawo waya ya USB ku muzannyi wo.
retry_guidance_step_2: 2. Nywa ku bbaatuuni ya hidden reset ng’okozesa ppini, ekikwaso ky’empapula oba empeta y’oku matu.
retry_guidance_step_3: 3. Teeka waya ya USB oddemu, olwo ogezeeko nate.

linux_usb_grant_desc: Waayo olukusa omulundi gumu app esobole okuwuliziganya n’ekyuma kyo.
linux_perms_ok_msg: Olukusa lwa USB & amateeka ga udev gateekeddwa bulungi. Empeereza ezitegekeddwa.

flash_sp_gui_tooltip: Ggulawo MediaTek SP Flash Tool GUI
status_app_reset_defaults: App ezzeemu ddala ku defaults, download cache cleared, era battery reminder ekomezeddwawo.
log_app_reset_defaults: Ensengeka ya app ezzeemu ddala ku defaults, download cache cleared, era battery reminder ekomezeddwawo (R).
flash_watch_waiting_hint: Kikuume nga kikutte, Rockbox etandise era emiramwa gyayo gijja kwongerwako otomatiki.
flash_watch_found: Omuzannyi azuuliddwa, n'ayongerako emiramwa gya Rockbox...
flash_watch_timeout_hint: Kebera nti eyingiziddwa mu pulagi era ng’ekoleezeddwa. Singa esigala nga nzikiza, nyweza ppini mu kinnya kya reset n’okwata bbaatuuni eri wakati (Y1) oba bbaatuuni y’amasannyalaze (abazannyi abalala) okuddamu okugitandika. Bwe kiba nga kikyali tekijja kutandika, firmware teyatwala, ssaako endala.
action_brom_detected: Ekyuma kizuuliddwa mu mbeera ya BROM...
action_flash_complete: Flash ewedde! Ggyako USB oddemu okutandika.
action_recover_powercycle: Power-cycle omuzannyi (kwata amaanyi ~10s), olwo oddemu okugiyunga - okuddamu okugezaako...
action_wait_mtk: Lindirira ekyuma kya MTK... Ggyako ekyuma era oyungeko USB.
action_da_stall: Ekyuma kyalekera awo okuddamu nga kitegeka agenti w'okuwanula. Gizikire ddala amaanyi, ddamu okugiyunga, era oddemu okugezaako.
action_detected_brom: Ekyuma kizuuliddwa (BROM mode) - okutegeka download agent...
action_detected_preloader: Ekyuma kizuuliddwa (preloader mode) - okutegeka download agent...
action_da_wait_back: Omuzannyi yalekera awo okuddamu ng’atandika agenti y’okuwanula. Nga tulindirira okuddayo...
action_restart_brom: Okuddamu okutandika omuzannyi mu mbeera ya BROM...
log_install_writing: Install in Progress - okuwandiika ebifaananyi bya firmware...
log_sparse_fmt: Ekifaananyi kya Android ekitono ekyazuuliddwa ku {part}, okukyusa mu nkola...
err_code_no_scatter: Tewali fayiro ya kusaasaanya mu kipapula
err_code_missing_images: Ebifaananyi bya firmware ebibula mu package
err_code_partition_table_invalid: Okukakasa emmeeza y'okugabanya kulemereddwa oluvannyuma lw'okuwandiika
err_sp_wrong_model: Oyungizza model y'omuzannyi enkyamu. Nywa ku bbaatuuni × okusazaamu okuteeka kuno, olwo londa pulogulaamu y’omuzannyi gw’oyungiddwa.
err_sp_timeout: Ekintu ekyo tekyalabako muzannyi oyo. Kikuume ng’ekizikiddwa n’okuggyamu pulaagi, olwo oyunge waya ya USB ng’obuuziddwa.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Omuzannyi yafunye amaanyi nga bukyali nnyo. Gizikire ddala amasannyalaze, olwo oddemu okugiyunga.
err_sp_download_fail: Okuwandiika kwasasika. Kebera waya ya USB ne port ne charge ya battery, olwo ogezeeko nate.
err_sp_da_init_sync: Agent w'okuwanula teyasobodde kutandika. Gezaako enkola endala eya flash.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: Agent w’okuwanula teyasobodde kusindikibwa ku muzannyi. Gizikireko amasannyalaze era oddemu okugiyunga.
err_sp_da_invalid_type: Omuzannyi yagaana agenti w'okuwanula (ensobi 6104). Kozesa Download Agent eyungiddwa ku SP Flash Tool, era okebere oba firmware ekwatagana n’omuzannyi ono.
err_sp_com_port: Ekintu kino tekyasobola kuggulawo serial port yaakyo. Ggalawo ebikozesebwa ebirala ebimasamasa era oddemu okuyunga.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Omukutu gwa USB COM tegwasobodde kuggulwawo (ensobi 1013). Okuddamu okutandika kompyuta yo kijja kusumulula omwalo ogusibiddwa. Nsaba oddemu okutandika kompyuta yo oddemu ogezeeko.
err_sp_enable_dram: Ekintu ekyo tekyasobola kutandika kujjukira kw’omuzannyi. Kozesa package ezimbiddwa ku model eno yennyini.
err_sp_storage_read: Ekintu ekyo tekyasobola kusoma tterekero ly’omuzannyi. Kebera okuyungibwa; ekyuma kiyinza okuba n'ensobi mu hardware.
err_attempt_timeout: Ekintu ekimasamasa tekyalaga nkulaakulana yonna mu sikonda {seconds}, kale okugezaako kuno kwayimirizibwa.
err_connection_failed_desc: Teyasobodde kuteekawo kakwate kanywevu n’omuzannyi. Kakasa nti ekyuma kizikiddwa (kozesa ppini okunyiga bbaatuuni ya reset bwe kiba kyetaagisa), ggyamu USB, era oddemu okugiyunga nga osabiddwa.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Okumasamasa kwasasika oba omulimu gw'okuwandiika gwalemererwa. Kebera oba waya ya USB eyingiziddwa bulungi era nga bbaatule erina chajingi emala, olwo ogezeeko nate.
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Ekintu ekimasamasa kiraga layini y’emu okumala sekondi {seconds} ezisembyeyo era tekirabika nga kigenda mu maaso n’okuwandiika firmware. Flash eyinza okuba nga yalemereddwa. Bwe kiba nti kino kyali kisembayo ku kugezaako emirundi ebiri nga buli nkola eri ku nkola eyinza okugwa emabega wakati waabwe, oba singa MTKClient yokka y’eriwo ku kyuma kino, ddamu okutandika kompyuta era ogezeeko nate.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: MTKClient yokka y'eriwo ku kussaako kuno. Flash eyinza okuba nga yalemereddwa. Nsaba oddemu okutandika kompyuta era ogezeeko nate.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Kompyuta eno era esobola okugiteeka ng’okozesa SP Flash Tool. Bw’oba ​​osobola, kyusa ku SP Flash Tool oddemu ogezeeko.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Flash eyinza okuba nga yalemereddwa. Nsaba osome obubaka waggulu era oddemu okutandika kompyuta nga tonnaddamu kugezaako. Bw’onyiga OK, app ejja kufuluma osobole okuddamu okutandika.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Ekipapula kya firmware kibulamu fayiro y'okusaasaanya oba fayiro z'ebifaananyi ezeetaagisa. Nsaba oddemu okuwanula ekipapula oba londa fayiro ya firmware enzijuvu.
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Fayiro y'okukakasa gy'olonze ebuze, njereere oba tesobola kuwandiikibwa. Londa fayiro entuufu, oba girongoose mu Settings, olwo oddemu flash.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Ekintu ekimasamasa oba ddereeva w’enkola ezeetaagisa tebyasobodde kutandikibwawo. Nsaba okebere olukusa lw'enkola, ensengeka ya ddereeva, oba ddamu okuteeka enkola.
err_driver_missing_desc: Ensobi eno eyinza okubaawo nga ddereeva wa MediaTek USB tateekeddwamu. Nywa ku Download Drivers okuteeka ddereeva wa MediaTek USB, okuddamu okutandika kompyuta yo, n’oddamu okugezaako.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Fayiro ya firmware etekeddwa mu tterekero ebuze. Londa Londa Software okuddamu okuzimba fayiro eziggiddwamu oba okuddamu okuwanula archive ya firmware. Kino kizibu kya fayiro ya wano, so si nsonga ya kuyungibwa kwa USB.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Ddayo ku Londa Software okuddamu okuzimba oba okuwanula ekintu kya firmware.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Ensobi etasuubirwa yabaddewo mu kiseera ky'okussaako ({detail}). Ggyako omuzannyi amasannyalaze gonna, ddamu okuyunga nga osabiddwa, era ogezeeko nate.
flash_method_confirm: Enkola y’okussaamu ekyusiddwa n’efuuka {method}. Kakasa nti omuzannyi aggyiddwaako pulaagi era ng’azikiddwa, olwo onyige ku Next.
flash_failover_note: {method} teyafunye kuteeka kutandika. Oluvannyuma lw’omuzannyi okuggyibwako amasannyalaze n’okuggyibwako pulaagi, {other} ejja kukozesebwa mu kifo ky’ekyo.
themepack_card_desc: Mulimu emiramwa emirungi egy’ekitundu, ebifaananyi eby’emabega eby’obulungi obw’amaanyi, n’empandiika ezikoleddwa mu ngeri ey’enjawulo ku by’okwolesebwa ebya 360p.
themepack_step1_title: Omutendera 1: Yunga mu USB Storage Mode
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Ggyako omuzannyi wo ng’okwata bbaatuuni ya Power.
2. Rockbox bw’etandika, ssaako waya ya USB mu kompyuta yo.
3. Singa osabibwa ku screen y’omuzannyi, kakasa USB Storage mode ekyuma ne kirabika nga drive.
themepack_step2_title: Omutendera 2: Londa Any Folder ku Player
themepack_step2_desc: Olw’okuba enkola z’emirimu (nga macOS) zikweka dotfiles (nga .rockbox) mu butonde, osobola okulonda folda YONNA oba ekikolo kya drive ku muzannyi wo. Tujja kukufunira oba okukolera .rockbox directory mu ngeri ey'otoma.
themepack_complete: Theme pack essiddwa bulungi! Kati osobola okuggyako omuzannyi wo mu ngeri ey’obukuumi n’olonda omulamwa mu Rockbox (Settings > Theme Settings).
themepack_err_not_found: Teyasobodde kuzuula oba okutandikawo dayirekita ya .rockbox ku ddiivu erongooseddwa. Nsaba okakasizza nti olonze folda ku muzannyi wo.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Omutendera 1: Ddamu okutandika omuzannyi era oddemu okuyunga
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Ggyako waya ya USB.
2. Teeka omuzannyi amaanyi okuddamu okutandika era oleke kibuuke mu Rockbox.
3. Rockbox bw’emala okukola, ddamu okuyunga waya ya USB, olwo onyige Continue.
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: App eno etunuulidde omukutu gwa ADB (okutuuka ku sikonda 30). Singa ekyuma kizuulibwa, emiramwa gikyusibwa era omuzannyi n’addamu okutandika otomatiki. Bwe kitaba ekyo, buuka mu maaso ku USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: Okulinda ekyuma kya ADB... (okutuuka ku sikonda 30)
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Tewali kyuma kya ADB kyazuuliddwa mu sikonda 30; okugenda mu maaso ne USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Tewali ADB binary eriwo ku app; okugenda mu maaso ne USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Okukyusa ADB kulemereddwa; okugwa okudda mu USB Storage Mode
rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Teeka ng’oyita mu USB Storage Mode
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Ssobozesa USB Storage Mode ku player esobole okulabika nga drive.
2. Londa folda YONNA ku muzannyi wansi (.rockbox, Music, Themes, oba drive root, folda ya .rockbox enkweke esangibwa automatically).
3. App egatta emiramwa n’empandiika za 360p mu, n’ewandiika ku fayiro ez’amannya ge gamu.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Kati osobola okuggyako omuzannyi mu ngeri ey’obukuumi n’olonda omulamwa mu Rockbox (Settings > Theme Settings).
rockbox_cleanup_failed_note: Sofutiweya yo empya yateekebwamu, naye ekitabo ekikadde ekya .rockbox teyasobodde kuggyibwawo. Ssaako .rockbox folder ku player n'omukono bw'oba oyagala entandikwa ennyonjo.
rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: Abazannyi abasukka mu omu be bayungiddwa. Ggyako endala olekewo eyo yokka eteekebwamu.
rockbox_stage_pushing: Omuzannyi azuuliddwa. Okuteeka emiramwa gy'ekitundu & fonts...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Kwata bbaatuuni eri wakati okussaako amaanyi ku Y1 yo, okuddamu okuyunga USB, n’olonda USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Kwata bbaatuuni y’amasannyalaze okutandika omuzannyi wo, okuddamu okuyunga USB, n’olonda USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_step1_disconnect_power_on: Nsaba oggyeko era okole amasannyalaze ku {model} yo, olwo onyige Next
rockbox_step1_power_on_button: Ggyako USB, kwata {button} okutandika {model} yo, olwo onyige Next.
rockbox_step_standalone_power_on_usb: Teeka waya ya USB ku {model} yo, olwo onyige Next.
rockbox_step_select_rockbox_folder: Nsaba olonde omuzannyi yennyini oba folda ya .rockbox
rockbox_select_device_prompt: Muzannyi ki gw’oteeka emiramwa gya Rockbox?
rockbox_select_software_question: Sofutiweya ki ekola ku muzannyi wo?
rockbox_select_software_hint: Londa player yo ne software waggulu, oba giyunge ku USB okugizuula otomatiki.
completion_installed_get_themes_non_dona: Tutadde {software} ku {model} yo. Osobola {get_themes} nga onyiga ku {palette} button.
completion_installed_guide_and_themes_no: Tutadde {software} ku {model} yo. Nywa ku {globe} okutuuka ku {view_guide}, oba {get_themes} ng’onyiga ku bbaatuuni ya {palette}.
completion_installed_get_themes_donation: Osobola {get_themes} ku {model} yo ng’okozesa akabonero ka Get Themes wansi.
completion_installed_guide_and_themes_do: Goberera emitendera gy’okuteekawo okutuuka ku {view_guide}, ne {get_themes} ku {model} yo wansi.
completion_themes_failed_get_themes_non_: Tutadde {software} ku {model} yo, naye emiramwa tegyasobodde kukoppololwa mu ngeri ya otomatiki. Osobola {get_themes} nga onyiga ku {palette} button.
completion_themes_failed_get_themes_dona: Emiramwa tegyasobola kukoppololwa mu ngeri ya otomatiki. Osobola {get_themes} mu ngalo ng’okozesa bbaatuuni eri wansi.
completion_240p_manual_heading: {software} ku {model} ewagira emiramwa gya iPod Classic egya 240p
completion_240p_manual_body: Teweetaaga 360p theme pack — nyweza {get_themes} okulambula emiramwa gya 240p egikwatagana.
settings_get_240p_themes_link: Funa emiramwa gya 240p Y1 / Y2 / iPod Classic
settings_save_360p_themes_zip_saved: Emiramwa gya 360p giterekeddwa ZIP okutuuka ku {path}
rockbox_reconnect_after_disconnect: Omukutu gwa USB gwabula. Ddamu otandike {model} yo era oddemu okuyunga waya ya USB okugenda mu maaso.
rockbox_paperclip_restart_tip: Amagezi: Kozesa paperclip mu reset pinhole okuggyako amangu amasannyalaze n’okuddamu okutandika {model} yo.
rockbox_step2_connect_usb_storage: Nsaba oyunge {model} yo nga okozesa USB transfer mode
rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Nkusaba okole USB storage mode ku kyuma kyo era onyige Next
rockbox_step_usb_storage_folder: Nsaba okole USB storage mode ku {model} yo, olwo olonde drive eraga
rockbox_step_select_player_folder: Nsaba olonde omuzannyi yennyini oba emu ku folda eziriko
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_y1: Ggyako USB n’amasannyalaze ku Y1 yo, olwo onyige Next.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_other: Ggyako USB n’amasannyalaze ku {model} yo, olwo onyige Next.
rockbox_manual_guide:
1. Londa ‘USB Storage Mode’ ku muzannyi wo.
2. Nywa ku 'Browse Folder...' okulonda omuzannyi wo n'oteeka emiramwa.
rockbox_site_themes_note: Rockbox build eno ekozesa emiramwa 240×320, nga tegikuŋŋaanyiziddwa. Funa emiramwa egy'obwereere eri omuzannyi wo okuva ku mukutu gw'emilamwa gwa Rockbox:
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: Singa {model} yo tetandika, ggyamu USB, kwata button y’amasannyalaze okumala 10s okuddamu okugiteeka, era okole. Oba okuzzaawo pulogulaamu ezasooka.
err_storage_full_desc: Kompyuta yo eweddeko ekifo w’otereka. Nsaba osumulule ekifo ku disiki ku drive yo era ogezeeko nate.
legacy_cleanup_desc: Enkyusa ya Updater enkadde ekyali ku kompyuta eno era etwala ekifo ku disiki. Okugiggyako kisumulula ekifo ekyo.
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Ggyawo enkola ya Innioasis Updater enkadde n'ebitabo ebiwagira
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Kuuma Ebikozesebwa ku Mukutu gwa Android (ADB / Fastboot) nga biteekeddwako
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Bw'oba tokozesa ADB oba Fastboot ebweru wa Updater, ggyamu akabonero okuggyawo n'okuddamu okutereka ebirala.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: Yayonja bulungi okuteekebwako okw'edda n'okuzzaawo ekifo kya disiki.
settings_shortcut_updater: Omukugu mu kutereeza obulwadde bwa Innioasis
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: Enkyusa ya Updater enkadde ekyali ku kompyuta eno. Okugiggyamu kisumulula ekifo ku disiki.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: Kino kiggyawo ddala app enkadde, firmware eyawanuliddwa, ne fayiro ezisigaddewo.
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Ggyawo Ebikozesebwa bya Android Platform (ADB / Fastboot) nga bwe kiri? Londa Keep bw'oba okozesa ADB.
log_btn_goto_file_tip: Bikkula fayiro y'ebiwandiiko mu Finder / Explorer
log_btn_save_file_tip: Ggyayo fayiro ya log eragiddwa ku disiki
settings_arm64_driver_note: ARM64 Obuwagizi bwa Windows tebugezeseddwa. Ku laptop za Snapdragon ne RTX Spark, Zadig esobola okukozesebwa nga Driver Signature Enforcement eremeddwa okuteeka WinUSB oba libusb ku kyuma kya MT6227 Preloader mu Device Manager. Laba ekitabo ekikwata ku ddereeva wa ARM64 ku mitendera.
